pages.title: Setup and purpose
pages.text: The Gate Fabricator makes NOT, AND, OR, XOR, Signal Buffer, Signal Drop, and Signal Switch gates. It needs power and a sealed cleanroom.$(br2)Look up the desired gate in JEI to check its materials and layout.

pages.title: Using the result
pages.text: Load the 3×3 input area and collect the manufactured gate. Place it in a circuit cell with the $(l:siliconic:wafer_assembler)wafer assembler$(/l).$(br2)The arrow marks the output direction. Right-click to rotate a gate. Contaminated manufacturing results can be reclaimed in the $(l:siliconic:reprocessor)reprocessor$(/l).

pages.title: Logic gates
pages.text: Signals above zero count as on. NOT outputs 15 when its rear input is off. Signal Buffer outputs 15 when its rear input is on.$(br2)AND, OR, and XOR read their side inputs:$(br)AND: both on$(br)OR: at least one on$(br)XOR: exactly one on$(br)The output is 15 when the condition is met, otherwise 0.

pages.title: Signal control
pages.text: Signal Drop subtracts its configured amount from the rear input, stopping at zero. Hold redstone and right-click the gate in the editor to cycle the drop amount.$(br2)Signal Switch passes its rear input when either side control is on. It preserves signal strength.
